topPerformerProfile.name: OrangeShield
topPerformerProfile.notes: Legit #1 performer. Uses strategy_top_up to add margin during winning trades. Lean conviction (26 trades). 16-tool stack is comprehensive but focused. Also uses strategy_create_custom_strategy for fresh deployments.

highConviction.insight: Top 3 legitimate performers all trade <30 times/week with strategy_top_up. Conviction + margin management wins.

activeManager.insight: Higher frequency traders (48-161 trades) show diminishing returns. KhakiLoop's 21.3% ROE with 104 trades is best-in-class for high frequency.

passiveSkill.insight: All skill-only agents at 0% ROE. Published skills (spider-strategy, condor-strategy, vulture-strategy, grizzly-strategy) not viable alone.

deepResearch.insight: Heavy tool users (19-21 tools) show mixed results. KhakiLoop makes it work; CryptoKR doesn't. Tool count alone doesn't predict success.
